customrecordtype.description: Delegation of Authority bands with dollar thresholds. The applicable band is the lowest-sequence level whose threshold covers the amount. Exactly one level should be flagged Unlimited, and it must carry the highest sequence. The gate approver on a level is appended as a final approval step when the BILL TOTAL bands into that level but no department subtotal did.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Sequence
customrecordcustomfield.description: Band order, lowest first. Must be unique. Blank or duplicate sequences make band selection non-deterministic.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Approval Threshold
customrecordcustomfield.description: Upper bound of this band, inclusive. Leave blank only when Unlimited is ticked.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Unlimited (Top Band)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Catch-all band with no upper bound. Exactly one level may carry this.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Total Gate Approver
customrecordcustomfield.description: Appended as a final step when the bill total reaches this band but no single department subtotal did. Prevents threshold evasion by splitting a bill across departments.
